ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows the decomposition reaction of hydrogen peroxide 2H2O2(aq) → 2H2O(l) + O2(g). In the container at t = 0 s, there is H-O-O-H labeled x8, that is, 8 H2O2 molecules; in the container at t = 200 s, H-O-O-H is labeled x4, that is, 4 H2O2 molecules; in the container at t = 400 s, H-O-O-H is labeled x2, that is, 2 H2O2 molecules.
